evaluation.rationale: The notes capture the majority of the important information, including the branch cut change, regression status, and blockers. However, there are two critical errors: the notes contradict themselves by assigning Ravi to complete MOB-1431 while also noting it was reassigned to Katya, and they report load testing the workout history endpoint as a firm action item for Theo when it was only a preference. Several minor details and numbers were also omitted, leading to partial scores for some facts.
